prompt: The stream produces no output. Why?
code:
Stream<Integer> s = Stream.of(1, 2, 3);
s.filter(n -> n > 1);  // no terminal operation
choices: filter() is not a valid stream operation
Streams are lazy — without a terminal operation, no elements are processed
filter() returns null instead of a stream
explanation: Stream operations are lazy. filter() creates a new stream description but doesn't execute until a terminal operation (collect, forEach, count, etc.) is called. Fix: s.filter(n -> n > 1).forEach(System.out::println);
